name: Love Hina: Ronin 15
source:
Love Hina: Ronin 15 is a one-of-a-kind weight gain visual novel based upon a fanfiction of a series originally written by Ken Akamatsu.

Motoko Aoyama, a young swordswoman/exorcist of the Shinmeiryu Swordschool, one day finds her once healthy lifestyle interrupted when a dueling injury leaves her housebound for several months. During this change of pace, she learns of the joys of food and gorging herself as a result of her boredom, as well as the effects of her new found fat on those around her, including her secret love interest. Her delightful days of watching her belly grow and the acceptance of her new flabby figure are interrupted, however, as a demonic presence once thought sealed away returns to take its revenge on the school and its residents, including Motoko's visiting roommates. It is now up to her to put her hunger pangs aside in favor of her sword and fight through her former friends in order to save a man she loves before the spirit can fatten her to immobility and beyond.

[From [url=http://animexpansion.com/Games/LoveHinaRonin15/ronin15-about.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
《Love Hina：浪人15》是一款独一无二的增重视觉小说，改编自赤松健创作系列的同人小说。

神明流剑术学校年轻剑士兼驱魔师青山素子，曾拥有健康的生活方式。一天，她因决斗受伤，被迫在家休养数月。生活节奏改变后，她因无聊发现了食物和暴食的乐趣，也注意到新长出的脂肪对身边人的影响，包括自己暗恋的人。她享受着腹部逐渐变大、接受肥胖身材的日子，却被打断：曾被封印的恶魔重新出现，要向学校及其居民复仇，包括来访的室友们。如今，她必须将饥饿感抛在脑后，拿起剑，击败曾经的朋友，拯救心爱的男人，否则恶灵会让她胖到无法行动，甚至更糟。

[译自[url=http://animexpansion.com/Games/LoveHinaRonin15/ronin15-about.html]官方网站[/url]]
